name: The Spill
facts:
Sleeping particles cover the surface in six colours.
Shine them off, let them burn out, then collect what is left behind.
flavor: It was only a little paint. Then it started to glow.
witnessed: The surface lay covered in sleeping particles of six colours.

name: First Light
facts:
A woken particle is a pigment: while it shines, its colour acts on its ring.
Its colour does a job to everything inside its ring.
Life only runs down while it shines: (mass ÷ energy) × {life_ms} ms.
flavor: A spark that remembers what colour it was.
witnessed: A particle was touched and woke: it shone, and the colours around it stirred.

name: Ember Remnant
facts:
A pigment that runs dry, or fails to collapse, leaves a Dim Remnant.
Collect it for DEPTH. A failed collapse keeps {dim_mass_pct}% mass and {dim_energy_pct}% energy.
flavor: What is left when the light gives up.
witnessed: A pigment's light ran out, and a dim ember was left where it had been.

name: Collapse
facts:
A big, colour-balanced, energetic pigment collapses: mass > {collapse_mass}, energy ≥ {collapse_energy}.
A Point always has a ring, and always loses life.
flavor: Too much light for one small thing.
witnessed: Once it had grown big and bright enough, the pigment collapsed into a Point.

name: Afterglow
facts:
When a Point runs out of life it bursts in a nova and leaves a Bright Remnant.
The remnant keeps {dim_mass_pct}% of its mass and {dim_energy_pct}% of its energy.
flavor: The glow stays after the star is gone.
witnessed: Once enough time passed, the Point burst, and a bright remnant was left in its glow.

name: Neutron Remnant
facts:
Two Bright Remnants collided hard: a Neutron.
Two Bright Remnants colliding hard make an exotic remnant. Middling colours, not enough speed and spin together: a Neutron.
It breathes: things in its range are Enlarged while it is big and Shrunk while it is small.
flavor: It inhales the small and exhales the great.
witnessed: Two bright remnants struck each other hard and became one heavy, strange remnant.

name: Magnetic Remnant
facts:
Very lopsided or very balanced colours make a Magnetic Remnant.
Each half turns what it touches to its own colour.
flavor: Two poles, one argument.
witnessed: Two remnants met, and what came of them pulled colours its way.

name: Pulsing Remnant
facts:
Fast, fast-spinning collisions make a Pulsing Remnant.
Its beam shines what it reaches on its first side and collects loose remnants it touches; the second side switches nothing off.
flavor: A heartbeat with an opinion.
witnessed: Two remnants struck, spinning fast, and what came of them began to beat.

name: The Dark Remnant
facts:
It breaks every Lens and Gate, freezes everything, then draws it all in.
A Point of mass ≥ {dark_mass} makes one.
flavor: Everything that shone, once.
witnessed: Something grew heavy and black; everything stopped, then was drawn into it.

name: Surface Cleared
facts:
Nothing is left to shine. The surface washes to white and every remnant is collected for you.
Right-click the box to make a new surface.
flavor: Clean. For now.
witnessed: The last light went out, and the surface washed to white.

name: Unwinding
facts:
A point circled a still one {spindle_orbits} times and earned a Spindle.
Use it on a Point or Pigment to unwind it back into particles.
flavor: Round and round, until it came undone.
witnessed: One point kept circling another until the circling came undone.

name: In Pursuit
facts:
One point followed another long enough to earn a String.
It kept the same speed and spin for {string_seconds} seconds.
Load it, then fire pigments and Points at the cursor.
flavor: Always one step behind, and perfectly happy.
witnessed: One point chased another, and kept chasing.

name: Stillness
facts:
Five points held perfectly still, close together, for {weave_seconds} seconds.
Click the Weave item to link lit points into Patterns.
flavor: The hardest thing to do here is nothing.
witnessed: Five points sat close together and did not move.

name: Prism Pattern
facts:
A closed 3-point loop, held steady: a Prism.
What its edges touch takes the first point's colour.
flavor: Three points, every colour.
witnessed: Three points were joined in a loop, and the loop held.

name: Knot Pattern
facts:
A 3-point loop with a spur reaching inside: a Knot.
What its edges touch becomes remnants.
flavor: Some things are better left tied.
witnessed: Three points made a loop, with one line reaching inside it.

name: Gate Pattern
facts:
A closed 4-point loop: a Gate.
It locks its contents in. A Key repeating its post pattern opens it.
flavor: It only opens for the right song.
witnessed: Four points were joined in a loop, and the loop held.

name: Key Pattern
facts:
A 3-point loop with two spurs outside it: a Key.
It opens a Gate, or with enough matching Points ends the surface with a Dark Remnant.
flavor: Shaped like the thing it opens.
witnessed: Three points made a loop, with two lines reaching out of it.

name: Lens Pattern
facts:
A closed 5-point loop: a Lens.
Fill a loop with glass. Crack it enough and it breaks into Bright Remnants.
flavor: Look closer. It looks back.
witnessed: Five points were joined in a loop, and the loop held.

name: Dim Relic
facts:
Two Dim Remnants at max size merged into one Dim relic (or an ECLIPSE Point burst).
It collects as 100. Two Dim relics meeting become a Dark Remnant.
flavor: Two embers, one coal.
witnessed: Two large embers met and became one deeper coal.

name: Bright Relic
facts:
A CRYSTALIZE Point burst and left a Bright relic.
It collects as 100 and never merges: it reflects off other remnants.
flavor: Light that kept its edges.
witnessed: A crystal Point burst, and what it left kept its edges.

name: The Surface Map
facts:
Every hex is a surface spilled from The Point at its centre. Click your hex to enter it.
Clear it and the hex is yours. The day runs from Twilight to Midnight.
flavor: So many spills. So little time.
witnessed: Spilled surfaces lay side by side around a point of light.

name: Claimed
facts:
A cleared hex is yours: white, or dark if a Dark Remnant cleared it.
Captured hexes next to each other can merge.
flavor: One clean surface. The map remembers.
witnessed: A surface was cleared, and its hex on the map took its colour.

name: Merge
facts:
Three touching captures merged: the map shrinks by a ring.
Three Dark Remnants swirl into one great one and pull in three rings.
flavor: Many surfaces, one shape.
witnessed: Three captured hexes touching each other became one, and the map drew in.

name: Message in a Bottle
facts:
A bottle floated onto the lake with a letter rolled up inside.
Someone else was here. There are {letters_total} letters to find; the ones you find are kept in the Guide (Letters).
flavor: Somebody, somewhere, hoped you would read this.
witnessed: A bottle floated onto the lake.

name: Descent
facts: You stepped into the centre. A deeper map begins.
flavor: Under every surface, another.
witnessed: You stepped into the centre and fell to a deeper map.

name: Constellation
facts:
A Weave joined bright hexes into a constellation.
Each time of day it gives you one of its item. A newer one crossing it breaks it.
flavor: Light, drawn between lights.
witnessed: Lines of light were drawn between bright hexes.

name: Full Circle
facts:
A whole ring of clears, all of one kind, ended the day: the rings beyond it fell into the Point.
The ring is used up, the value is shared over what is left inside, and a new day begins at Twilight.
flavor: Everything comes back around.
witnessed: A whole ring closed, and everything beyond it fell into the Point.

name: Bright Star
facts: A ring of nothing but bright hexes closed around the Point.
flavor: A sun made of cleaned surfaces.
witnessed: A ring of bright hexes closed around the Point.

name: Dark Star
facts: A ring of nothing but Dark Remnants closed around the Point.
flavor: It shines inward.
witnessed: A ring of dark hexes closed around the Point.

name: Full Collapse
facts:
A full circle at ring 1 or 2, or every hex cleared: everything fell into the Point. The run is won.
Back at the main menu the days start over. Your items and discoveries are kept.
flavor: Every spill, accounted for.
witnessed: Everything fell into the Point.

name: The Rift
facts:
Mass of {rift_mass} or more gathered in one place and tore the surface open along a line.
Whatever it opened over was lost; everything else was drawn across to it.
On the Surface Map the hex is gone: a scar, and the hexes beside it drained.
flavor: Too much light in one place.
witnessed: Too much gathered in one place, and the surface tore open along a line.

name: Rubber Duck
facts:
A Dark Remnant came out as a rubber duck. The surface carries on.
Click it to add it to your collection (Guide → Ducks).
flavor: Squeak.
witnessed: Something went dark, and out of it came a rubber duck.
